### [`scene1_bitmap_packed`](../../../src/scene1_packed_a.asm#L6) `$44E3-$44E4`

*data*

Packed bitmap of scene 1 for the unpacker $12ce (pointer at $134c+2). The word is the offset $09fd from this address to the last control byte at $4ee0.
